name: Honda CTX700
engine: 670 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected, manual or DCT automatic
intro: Honda's low, easy-going 700 twin. Some early ABS bikes had a recall, and 2014-2015 bikes a starter relay recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 235 early 2014 CTX700ND bikes are in recall 13V307 (ABS modulator). 2014-2015 CTX700s are in recall 15V439 (starter relay).

J: DCT bikes have no clutch lever. Check the DCT fluid and filter at the service intervals in the manual.

recalls.what: ABS may malfunction and let the wheels lock.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the ABS modulator free.

recalls.what: Starter relay switch can fail, so the bike may not start, or the starter may keep running.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the starter relay free.
